label: 1x2 FBT fibre coupler, 50:50, SC/APC
description: 1x2 fused-biconical-taper coupler, 50:50 split, dual-window 1310/1490 nm, SC/APC connectors on the common and both leg ports. Insertion loss <=3.9 dB per leg with connectors (3.6 dB bare fibre + 0.3 dB connector allowance), return loss >=55 dB (APC), PDL <=0.1 dB, bidirectional and unpowered.
